snippet.title: Ritterschlag | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Ritterschlag now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4512400/Ritterschlag/

Ritterschlag is here! A roguelike autobattler built around smart decisions, evolving builds, and short, focused runs. Every session challenges you to adapt, combine items, and push your strategy further.

Set in a medieval-inspired world, Ritterschlag captures the essence of modern indie autobattlers while delivering a clear and distinct gameplay loop.

Watch the announcement trailer now and get your first look at what’s coming.
Follow the game on Steam to stay up to date: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4512400/Ritterschlag/
